_meta.description: Brand intelligence, market trends, forum-sourced reputation, and decision-making rules for tattoo needle/cartridge analysis
sources: web research — industry publications, supplier blogs, artist reviews
_meta.update_instructions: This file should be updated quarterly or when significant new market information becomes available. Run reddit_sentiment_scraper.py and update brand profiles accordingly.

kwadron.signature_advantage: Hybrid multi-stage taper system — steep front-end + shallow rear-end for compound ink control
kwadron.membrane: clear_thin — low resistance design, faster ink delivery

praise: exceptional consistency — very few duds per box
multi-stage taper gives unique ink control, good for both lining and shading
clear membrane makes visual inspection easy
black+gold aesthetic looks premium on social media
complaints: price increased 15-20% in 2024-2025
some artists report occasional QC drift on high-count magnums (>14)
black housing makes flow channel invisible — can't verify internal design
artist_sentiment.common_comparisons: Often compared to Cheyenne Safety as a slightly more affordable but equally consistent alternative. Kwadron preferred by artists who want the multi-stage taper advantage.

kwadron.market_position: Strong in Europe. Growing in US market via online distribution. Popular among mid-to-high-end artists.

cheyenne.signature_advantage: Capillary reservoir (Capillary series) — 10x ink flow duration via capillary tube in tip. ISO 13485 certified manufacturing.

product_lines.safety: translucent blue, ISO 13485, the industry benchmark. Visible white silicone membrane.
product_lines.craft: translucent pink, budget line, fewer configurations. Good value. Made in China, Cheyenne branded.
product_lines.capillary: translucent purple, capillary tube ink reservoir, latest tech. 10x longer ink flow. Premium line.

praise: industry gold standard — trusted by top artists worldwide
Safety series membrane sets the benchmark for backflow prevention
Capillary series genuinely changes ink flow dynamics — less dipping, more consistent saturation
tight quality control — near-zero duds
complaints: premium pricing — 30-50% more than Kwadron
Craft series (pink) perceived as lower quality despite Cheyenne branding
proprietary thread causes occasional fit issues on non-Cheyenne machines
Capillary series has learning curve — ink flow behaves differently
artist_sentiment.common_comparisons: The benchmark everyone compares to. 'If it's good enough for Cheyenne's QC, it's good enough for me.' Some artists find them overpriced vs Kwadron.

cheyenne.market_position: Global market leader in premium segment. Strongest in Europe and regulated markets (ISO certification matters).

blackclaw.signature_advantage: Metal (aluminum/steel) cartridge housing — unique in the industry. Precision CNC machined. Custom grind taper options.
blackclaw.membrane: varies, some models membrane-less (relies on precision fit)

praise: metal housing is indestructible — no cracking, no warping
custom grind options let artists dial in exact taper preference
rainbow PVD finish is distinctive and photogenic
zero wobble — precision fit is unmatched
American made, small batch quality control
complaints: very expensive — 2-3x Kwadron price
metal housing heavier than plastic — changes machine balance
can't see flow channel at all (opaque metal)
membrane-less design concerns some artists about backflow
limited distribution — hard to get outside US
artist_sentiment.common_comparisons: Boutique choice for artists who want the absolute best build quality. Not a daily driver for most due to cost and weight.

blackclaw.market_position: Niche premium. Loyal following among high-end US artists. Aspirational brand — many artists want to use them but cost is prohibitive for volume work.

bigwasp.signature_advantage: Transparent housing — full visibility of flow channel, needle, and membrane. Gen 3/4 iterations show rapid improvement.

generation_evolution.gen_3: signature generation — clear shell, better QC, gained market trust
generation_evolution.gen_4: latest — further improved membrane, color coding

praise: best value proposition — 80% of premium quality at 50% of price
transparent housing lets you see the needle and flow channel clearly
Gen 3+ quality is surprisingly consistent
great for high-volume work where cost matters
clear shell is photogenic for social media content
complaints: Gen 2 and earlier had notable QC issues (barbs, wobble)
occasional dud in every box (though improving with each generation)
packaging feels cheap — doesn't match premium brand presentation
naming/generation confusion — hard to tell Gen 3 from Gen 4 visually
artist_sentiment.common_comparisons: 'Budget Cheyenne alternative.' Artists recommend Gen 3+ only. The clear housing is genuinely useful for inspection.

bigwasp.market_position: Strong in budget segment. Popular for high-volume shops, apprentices, and artists who value see-through housing. Rapidly improving.

dragonhawk_mast.signature_advantage: Vast product range. Mast Pro series is their premium line. Rainbow anodized option is visually distinctive.

praise: best entry-level option for apprentices
extremely affordable — good for practice on fake skin
improved significantly over 2023-2025
rainbow colors look interesting in photos
complaints: QC inconsistency — 2-3 duds per box not uncommon
barbs on needles — must inspect every cartridge before use
sharper than before but not premium-level sharp
membrane can leak/spit ink on some batches
artist_sentiment.common_comparisons: 'Fine for learning, graduate to Kwadron/Cheyenne when you start tattooing clients.' Widely recommended for practice only.

dragonhawk_mast.market_position: Dominant in beginner/apprentice segment. Large market share in Asia and entry-level Western markets. Improving reputation but still budget.

tatsoul.signature_advantage: Envy Gen 2 series — clear shell + colored label ring system for easy identification. Social media friendly aesthetics.

praise: Envy Gen 2 is well-regarded for consistency
color-coded label system makes configuration identification fast
clear shell + colored rings look great in content
good mid-point between budget and premium pricing
complaints: less established than Kwadron/Cheyenne — fewer long-term reviews
distribution limited in some regions

tatsoul.market_position: Growing mid-tier brand. Popular on Instagram due to photogenic packaging. Targeting artists who want mid-range quality with visual appeal.

cnc.signature_advantage: Solid black housing with groove cutout for finger placement — ergonomic design feature. Police series has distinctive branding.

praise: ergonomic groove design is genuinely useful
aggressive pricing
solid black looks professional
complaints: QC inconsistency
membrane issues on some batches
can be confused with Kwadron due to black housing

magicmoon.signature_advantage: Frosted/matte translucent housing — unique visual differentiation from clear/glossy competitors

praise: frosted finish is distinctive and non-slip
good value
complaints: limited track record
less established distribution

2025_2026_major_shifts.description: Cheyenne Capillary series leads with 10x ink flow via capillary tube. Other brands likely to follow. This is the biggest needle tech advance since membrane standardization.
2025_2026_major_shifts.impact: high — changes how artists work (less dipping, different hand speed)
2025_2026_major_shifts.detection_cue: Look for translucent purple housing (Cheyenne Capillary) or visible capillary tube inside tip

2025_2026_major_shifts.description: 15-needle Curved Magnum is becoming the go-to shading/packing configuration. Artists report faster saturation with less trauma.
2025_2026_major_shifts.impact: high — affects which configurations are most popular in content/photography
2025_2026_major_shifts.detection_cue: CM needle type with count 15 — visible curved arc arrangement

2025_2026_major_shifts.description: Driven by micro-realism and fine line tattoo popularity. #06 (0.20mm) and bugpin #08 (0.25mm) growing fast.
2025_2026_major_shifts.impact: medium — affects which products are featured as 'new' or 'trending'
2025_2026_major_shifts.detection_cue: Labels showing 06XX or 08XX prefix, bugpin branding

2025_2026_major_shifts.description: 316L stainless steel with molybdenum becoming expected. ISO/CE certification now a marketing requirement.
2025_2026_major_shifts.impact: medium — brands using medical-grade materials should be highlighted

2025_2026_major_shifts.description: Lotus Needles (by Ryan Ussher + TomTom) is the latest. Artists trust artist-founded brands over corporate ones.
2025_2026_major_shifts.impact: medium — new brand detection is valuable for competitive intelligence
2025_2026_major_shifts.detection_cue: Packaging with artist names, 'co-founded by', 'artist developed'

2025_2026_major_shifts.description: Brands adding visual quality signals: color-coded backstems, clear windows, printed configuration on each cartridge.
2025_2026_major_shifts.detection_cue: Color-coded elements, printed labels on individual cartridges

reasoning_framework.description: How to reason about new needle products using visual + market intelligence
when_to_activate: a new/unknown brand is detected (brandPrediction = unknown but cartridge visible)
a known brand shows an unfamiliar visual feature (new shell color, new membrane design)

brand_positioning.question: Where does this brand sit in the market?
decision_rules: metal housing → almost always premium/ultra-premium positioning
translucent colored shell → likely Cheyenne or premium brand
clear shell → budget to mid-tier (unless branded Kwadron/TATSoul)
individual blister + high quality print → mid to premium
loose/bulk packaging → budget

quality_indicator.question: What quality level does this product signal?
visual_cues: housing finish — matte metal > glossy plastic > basic plastic
label detail — full printed specs vs minimal branding
needle tip exposure — centered and clean vs off-center
decision_rules: silicone_high membrane + colored translucent shell → likely Cheyenne Safety = premium quality
clear thin membrane + black gold housing → Kwadron = premium quality
white standard membrane + clear shell → generic/budget
metal housing → BlackClaw or boutique = ultra-premium

newness_detection.question: Is this a new product or configuration I haven't seen before?
visual_cues: unfamiliar shell color not in known color palettes
new membrane design (e.g. capillary tube visible)
decision_rules: unfamiliar shell color + new brand name → flag as potential new entrant
visible capillary tube in tip → Cheyenne Capillary or copy — this is current bleeding edge tech
unusual gauge/count combo (e.g. 1509CM) → possible new trending configuration
packaging with 'Lotus', 'SPARK', 'Neebol' → new brand — needs investigation

social_media_fit.question: How well would this product perform as social media content?
visual_cues: color distinctiveness — does the shell color pop against common backgrounds?
packaging aesthetics — is the box/branding instagrammable?
lighting reflection — does the housing produce appealing highlights?
configuration rarity — is this a common config (relatable) or exotic (intriguing)?
decision_rules: distinctive shell colors (rainbow, metal, translucent blue) → high visual content potential
black+gold → universally appealing aesthetic across all audiences
clear shell → lower visual impact but educational value (see-through = informative content)
rainbow/multi-color → high engagement on social feeds, especially video

competitive_intelligence.question: What does this product reveal about the brand's strategy or market direction?
visual_cues: is the brand iterating on housing design? (new gen markers)
are they copying a competitor's visual language?
is the packaging design improving (moving upmarket)?
are they adding visual QC signals (color coding, inspection windows)?
decision_rules: BigWasp transparent shell + increasing packaging quality → moving upmarket toward mid-tier
Dragonhawk adding Mast Pro line with better packaging → segmenting into premium sub-brand
any brand adding color-coded system → investing in user experience (positive signal)
capillary/visible flow channel design → following Cheyenne's lead in ink flow innovation

decision_output.format: 添加到 product_analysis 输出的 notes/reasoning 字段中

examples.new_brand_detected: Unbranded clear shell cartridge with capillary tube visible. Not Cheyenne (shell is clear not purple). Potential new entrant copying Cheyenne Capillary design. Quality indicators: white standard membrane (not silicone), basic blister pack. Likely budget copy of premium tech.
examples.trending_config: Kwadron 1015CM — 10 gauge 15-count Curved Magnum. This configuration is currently trending (2025-2026) for smooth black and grey shading. High content potential due to CM arrangement being visually distinctive in macro.
examples.quality_concern: Dragonhawk Mast Pro — improved packaging suggests they're targeting mid-tier. But membrane still white standard (not silicone). Potential gap between branding and actual quality. Worth watching.
examples.social_media_win: BlackClaw rainbow PVD Saber — extremely photogenic. Housing catches light in unique ways. High probability of good engagement on product shots. Configurations: 1003RL (lining) and 1205M1 (packing) — covers both popular use cases.

feedback_integration_protocol.description: How to incorporate external feedback and forum intelligence into needle analysis decisions

reddit.update_frequency: 要求运行 reddit_scraper weekly 更新 sentiment data

reputation_tracking_rules: 3+ negative signals from different sources on same brand in 30 days → flag reputation issue
new brand appearing in 5+ artist conversations in 30 days → trending — track it
brand improving packaging (visual detection) + forum sentiment stable/positive → moving upmarket
brand reducing packaging quality + increasing complaints → brand decline
